name: Westlake Robotics
summary: Westlake Robotics is a Hangzhou company developing embodied AI models and robot platforms. It originated from robotics and artificial intelligence research at Westlake University. Its work combines general robot behavior models with humanoid hardware, including the Titan O1 platform, and an open architecture for integrating AI with robot motion and perception.
